Great! Soccer Kid.name: Soccer Kid
Great! Soccer Kid.summary: Soccer Kid is a side-scrolling platform game released in 1993 for various home computers and consoles. Players control a young boy who uses his soccer ball to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles. The game’s story follows his quest to recover pieces of the World Cup trophy scattered across different countries. Levels feature themed environments based on locations such as England, Italy, Russia, Japan, and the United States.

Hello Kitty - Asobi no Omochabako.name: Hello Kitty Asobi no Omochabako
Hello Kitty - Asobi no Omochabako.summary: This interactive title takes the player to Hello Kitty's bedroom with a number of activities and features several different Sanrio characters. Activities vary from a slot machine, an art page with stickers, dressing up Hello Kitty, and a Janken game.
